articles.summary: Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open protocol launched by Anthropic to standardize the way LLMs use external tools. AI agents use MCP to enable multi-turn workflows, where an LLM (via products like [Claude Desktop](https://claude.ai/download) or [Cursor](https://docs.cursor.com/en/tools/mcp)) can select and coordinate between tools in multiple MCP servers. Since its introduction, MCP has quickly become the de facto standard for tool integrations with LLMs.
articles.title: Exploring Foundation Models' Tool-Use Efficacy
